title.en: Insert geometric means between two numbers

say.en: Between 4 and 16, the add-and-halve middle is 10, but the multiply-and-root middle is 8. Which one is bigger, always? In this lesson: Insert geometric means between two numbers.
Prove and apply A.M. is greater than or equal to G.M.

body.en: The G.M. of two positive numbers $a$ and $b$ is $G = \sqrt{ab}$, so that $a, G, b$ is a G.P. To insert $n$ numbers between $a$ and $b$ so that all $n + 2$ numbers form a G.P., use $b = ar^{n+1}$, i.e. $r = (b/a)^{1/(n+1)}$.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ಧನ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಗುಣೋತ್ತರ ಮಧ್ಯಕ √(ab). a ಮತ್ತು b ನಡುವೆ n ಮಧ್ಯಕಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಲು r = (b/a)^(1/(n+1)) ಬಳಸಿ.

narration.en: The geometric mean of a and b is the square root of a b. To insert n means, find r from b equals a r to the power n plus one.
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ಧನ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಗುಣೋತ್ತರ ಮಧ್ಯಕ √(ab). a ಮತ್ತು b ನಡುವೆ n ಮಧ್ಯಕಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಲು r = (b/a)^(1/(n+1)) ಬಳಸಿ.

say.en: The geometric mean of a and b is the square root of a b. To insert n means, find r from b equals a r to the power n plus one.
say.kn: ಎರಡು ಧನ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಗುಣೋತ್ತರ ಮಧ್ಯಕ the square root of ab. a ಮತ್ತು b ನಡುವೆ n ಮಧ್ಯಕಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಲು r equals (b over a)^(1 over n plus 1) ಬಳಸಿ.

narration.en: The geometric mean of two positive numbers a and b is root a b. For 4 and 16 it is 8, and 4, 8, 16 is a G.P.

say.en: The geometric mean of two positive numbers a and b is root a b. For 4 and 16 it is 8, and 4, 8, 16 is a G.P.

Draw a semicircle on a diameter a plus b. The radius is the A.M.; the half-chord at the join is the G.M. The radius is the longest such line.
Algebra says the same: root a minus root b, squared, is never negative. Equality holds only when a equals b.
The geometric mean of two positive numbers a and b is root a b. For 4 and 16 it is 8, and 4, 8, 16 is a G.P.

title.en: A.M. and G.M. in a semicircle

narration.en: The diameter is a + b, so the radius (green) is the A.M. The yellow half-chord at the point where a meets b has length √(ab), the G.M. It can never be taller than the radius.

body.en: For positive $a$ and $b$ let $A = \frac{a+b}{2}$ and $G = \sqrt{ab}$. Then $A - G = \frac{(\sqrt a - \sqrt b)^2}{2} \ge 0$, so $A \ge G$, with equality only when $a = b$. Also, $a$ and $b$ are the roots of $x^2 - 2Ax + G^2 = 0$.
body.kn: ಧನ a, b ಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ ಮಧ್ಯಕ A ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಗುಣೋತ್ತರ ಮಧ್ಯಕ G ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ; a = b ಆದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಎರಡೂ ಸಮ.

problem.en: Insert three numbers between 1 and 256 so that the five numbers form a G.P.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Insert three numbers between 1 and 256 so that the five numbers form a G.P.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Insert three numbers between 1 and 256 so that the five numbers form a G.P.
256 equals 1 times r to the power 4, so r to the power 4 equals 256 and r equals 4 or minus 4.
With r equals 4: 4, 16, 64. With r equals minus 4: minus 4, 16, minus 64.
So the answer is 4, 16, 64 (or minus 4, 16, minus 64).

problem.en: The A.M. and G.M. of two positive numbers are 10 and 8. Find the numbers.

steps.en: They are the roots of x² − 20x + 64 = 0, i.e. (x − 16)(x − 4) = 0.

For x is greater than 0, A.M. is greater than or equal to G.M. gives x plus k over x is greater than or equal to 2 the square root of k, with the minimum at x equals the square root of k. So x plus 1 over x is greater than or equal to 2 and x plus 9 over x is greater than or equal to 6.

Let the common value be k: a equals k to the power x, b equals k to the power y, c equals k to the power z. b squared equals ac gives k to the power 2y equals k to the power x to the power plus z, so 2y equals x plus z: x, y, z are in A.P.
